description: Update a bookkeeping voucher with the current version for optimistic locking. If the existing voucher is unchecked, the update must transition voucherStatus to open.

body.description: Voucher JSON with the current version field required for optimistic locking. If the existing voucher is unchecked, the update must transition voucherStatus to open; this constraint does not apply to vouchers already in other statuses.
